**Resubmitted: deviation at the fallback level, confidence 0.78 (validated ok:true, minimality passed).**

Repair made to the deterministic failure:

- **"Customer convenience termination present"** — Section 14 (p0079) previously described only "its election to terminate this Agreement", so the convenience right existed in substance but never in operative words. I added the four-word qualifier **"for convenience, without cause"** to that same sentence (9 words removed → 13 added, inside the expansion limit), leaving the ~30–60 day wind-down mechanic, the Section 4 carve-out and all payment terms untouched. Fallback element 1 is now carried by operative text rather than inference, and is mapped to operation 1.

Unchanged from the prior submission:

- Operation 2 still fixes the actual material breach: TrueLink's 30-day non-renewal right in Section 13 (p0078) becomes **ninety (90) days**, confined to the end of a term, while our own 30-day notice survives — covering fallback elements 3 and 4.
- Fallback element 2 remains **already_met**: no early-termination fee, penalty or unamortised charge exists anywhere; fees are charged per monthly invoice under Section 5(a).
- Preferred is expressly **not** claimed (no flat 30-day notice, no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees).

Residual diligence you flagged is now cleared: the cross-referenced Section 4 (p0043) is only a minimum support-period commitment, and Section 12 (p0070–p0077) is indemnity plus the liability cap — neither contains a TrueLink at-will termination right or any termination charge, so fallback elements 2–4 are not undercut. Note for the negotiation file: the "terminated pursuant to Section 12" cross-reference in Section 13 appears to be a mis-numbering for Section 14 (Termination), which we may wish to correct separately.
